extracted.name: Crispy Zucchini or Pumpkin Blossoms
extracted.description: These fried zucchini or pumpkin blossoms are a deliciously crispy treat to make every year when the zucchini in your garden starts to bloom.
instruction_lines: Stir flour, baking powder, basil, and Parmesan cheese together in a medium bowl; mix in water and eggs until smooth.

Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, dip blossoms in the batter to coat, and gently place a few at a time into the hot oil. Fry on each side until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towels.
